in_english.long_meaning: Siddique is an Arabic name that conveys the meaning of truth, veracity, sincerity, and uprightness in character. It is derived from the root 'siddiq' which means 'to be truthful' or 'to be sincere.' In Islamic tradition, Siddique is considered a laudatory epithet attributed to several companions of the Prophet Muhammad, including Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah, who was known for his unwavering commitment to truth and justice. The name Siddique has been used throughout Islamic history to signify a person of impeccable character, integrity, and honesty. In modern times, Siddique has become a popular name among Muslims worldwide, symbolizing the values of truthfulness, sincerity, and righteousness.
